Study ALL AVAILABLE specimens equally; UNAVAILABLE slots are absent evidence. Choose one coherent attested whole construction, do not blend incompatible variants, substitute modern Chinese, or reproduce reference brush outlines. Reconstruct original smooth centerline trajectories as a harmonious Gothic sans-serif MONOLINE drawing. Absolutely constant stroke width around 3% full canvas, round caps and round joins, precise straight bars and rounded smooth curves. No taper, swelling, brush pressure, texture, blobs, or serifs. Preserve every branch, detached stroke, counter, gap, contact and bar length relationship. Square1:1 canvas, one complete centered glyph within central70%, pure black strokes on fully TRANSPARENT background, generous margins. NO labels, text, codepoints, frames, grids, shadows, watermark, background, multiple glyphs. U+3D12C. All four available and agree. TOP TWO small separate threeprong Uforks. BELOW them one large tree/trident-like assembly: longcentralvertical from above two sideprongs tobaseline; two shorter sideverticalprongs each curves inward tojoin centerstem. Rightinwardbranch joinscenter slightly HIGHER than leftinwardbranch, preserving stepped/asymmetric joins seen in specimens. Centerstem continues down to ONE long centered horizontalbaselinebar. Lowerassembly detached from two upperforks. No crossbar across upperprongtops, no closedcounter, no extra topbar.
